tab.title: Virtual Machines
tab.noHost: Open Virtual Machines from a host.
tab.error: Could not read the VMs on this host.
tab.disabled: Virtual Machines is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.sudo: This host needs a root login, passwordless sudo or a saved Sudo Password.
tab.noKvm: no KVM, VMs will be slow

power.shutdownText: This asks the guest to shut down. It can take a minute, and a guest with no ACPI support may ignore it.
power.stopText: This cuts the power right away. Anything the guest has not saved is lost.

setup.missingText: Termix can install QEMU and libvirt on this host. It needs root, passwordless sudo or a saved Sudo Password.
setup.noConnect: Termix can't reach libvirt on this host
setup.noConnectText: Check that the libvirt service is running, and that the SSH user can use it.
setup.noKvm: This host has no /dev/kvm, so VMs would run with no hardware help. Turn on virtualization in the BIOS or for this VM.
setup.installText: This installs QEMU, libvirt and their tools with the host's package manager, starts the service and sets up the default network and storage pool.

vm.none: No VMs on this host yet
vm.noneHint: Press New VM to make one.
vm.name: Name
vm.autostartHint: Start this VM when the host boots.
vm.cloneStopped: Shut the VM down to clone it
vm.cloneStarted: Clone started. See Jobs for progress.
vm.deleteDisksHint: Removes disks no other VM uses. This can't be undone. ISOs and base images stay.

watch.start: Alert me when this VM stops

console.notRunning: Start the VM to use its console.
console.serialHint: Press Enter if the screen stays empty. The guest must run a getty on its serial port.
console.noRemoteDesktop: Turn on Remote Desktop to see this VM's screen. The serial console still works.
console.vncSaved: Saved. Shut the VM down and start it to use VNC.

hardware.nextStart: Changes apply the next time the VM starts.
hardware.detachText: The volume stays in its pool.

snapshot.name: Snapshot name
snapshot.noneHint: A snapshot saves the disks, and the memory of a running VM.
snapshot.revertText: Everything since this snapshot is lost.
snapshot.deleteText: The VM stays as it is now.

xml.hint: Advanced. The host checks the XML before saving and keeps a copy of the old one in /var/lib/termix-vms/backups.
xml.saveText: It applies the next time the VM starts.

new.title: New VM
new.name: Name
new.noIso: No ISOs in this pool. Download one under Storage.
new.sshKeyHint: Give a password, a key, or both. The password is stored only as a hash.
new.started: Making the VM. See Jobs for progress.
new.noUefi: This host has no UEFI firmware installed.
new.uefiHint: A UEFI VM can only take snapshots while it is shut down.
new.missingTools: This host is missing {{tools}}, which cloud images need.

storage.noneHint: Add a folder to keep VM disks in.
storage.forgetText: Libvirt stops using this pool. Files in its folder stay on the disk.
storage.deleteVolumeText: This removes the file. It can't be undone.
storage.downloadUrl: Download a file to this pool
storage.downloadHint: The host downloads it, so it keeps going with Termix closed.

network.title: Virtual networks
network.name: Name
network.stopText: VMs on this network lose their connection until it is back and they reconnect.

jobs.noneHint: New VMs, clones, snapshots and downloads show up here.

all.title: All VMs
all.noHosts: No hosts have Virtual Machines turned on
all.noHostsHint: Open a host in Manage and turn on Virtual Machines.

use.title: Use Virtual Machines
use.description: See VMs on hosts you can connect to, and change them on hosts you can edit.

console.title: Open VM consoles
console.description: Open the graphical and serial console of a VM on hosts you can edit.

enable.label: Enable Virtual Machines
enable.description: Manage KVM virtual machines on this host with libvirt.

useSudo.label: Use sudo
useSudo.description: Run libvirt commands with sudo. Turn off for a root login.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Show VMs but block every change from Termix.

connectUri.label: Libvirt connection
connectUri.description: The libvirt URI to use. Most hosts want qemu:///system.

showPanel.label: Show the VM panel beside terminals
showPanel.description: Adds a VM list to this host's terminal tabs.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the VM panel by itself
companionAutoOpen.description: Open the panel when a terminal opens.

companionSide.label: VM panel side
companionSide.description: Where the panel sits beside a terminal.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the edge button
companionEdgeButton.description: A small button on the terminal's edge opens the panel.
